messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Nested Tabsets
parts:
Hi,

I am developing an app with several charts and table so I am looking at nesting tabsets

Something like
tabsetPanel(
      tabPanel("Panel 1",
               tabsetPanel(
                  tabPanel("a", value = 1),
                  tabPanel("b",  value = 2), 
                  id = "firstPanel"
                 )
      ),
      
      tabPanel("Panel 2",
               tabsetPanel(
                  tabPanel("c", value = 3),
                  tabPanel("d",  value = 4), 
                  id = "secondPanel"
                 )
      ),
      id="myPanel"
    )

This seems to display OK but I am having a bit of problem referencing them

In conditional panels  should it be of the form

 condition = "input.myPanel.rankPanel == 1" or just  condition = "input.rankPanel == 1"

and likewise if I want to update a selectInput is

updateTabsetPanel(session, "secondPanel", selected= "4") correct?

cheers

messages.subject: Re: Nested Tabsets

You will have to test both input.myPanel and input.rankPanel/input.majorsPanel for each condition I think. For example:

"input.myPanel == 'World Rankings' && input.rankPanel == 'Player Timeline'"

messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Re: Nested Tabsets
parts:
Thanks Joe. That makes sense

I actually had problems using the conditions exactly as you suggested.
However, using the value rather than the id
viz
condition = "input.myPanel == 'World Rankings' && input.rankPanel == 1",

got it working
Maybe if there is a value stipulated then that has to be used

I have updated the gist in case anyone else should need this. I'm guessing there
may be a more elegant bootstrap navigation solution to nested tabsets

As for moving to the tab dependent on an input this would be an example that works
updateTabsetPanel(session, "majorsPanel", selected= "7")

Thanks again

Dear all,

I was facing the same problem, but the approach using something around

was not successful in my case.

I added also values in the main tabPanel and used

condition = "input.TAB_ALL == 102 && (input.TAB == 3 || input.TAB == 4)",
(here: TAB_ALL correspond to mypanel in the original example and TAB is comparable to rankPanel)

Best regards,
Jürgen
